name: VDL AI SEO
author: gtech25

sections.description:
VDL AI SEO helps you create SEO-friendly content faster — without leaving WordPress.

Designed for writers, site owners, and marketers who want clearer structure, stronger search intent alignment, and better on-page optimization while they write.

Key features:
* Generate SEO outlines based on topic and audience
* Analyze existing drafts and highlight improvements
* Optimize content for clarity, structure, and search intent
* Works directly inside the WordPress editor
* Lightweight, fast, and focused on writing quality

The plugin connects to an external AI service to generate results. You remain in control of when AI actions are triggered.

Works out of the box

Install, activate, and start using VDL AI SEO immediately.

Optionally, you can configure an API key or license in the plugin settings to enable AI-powered features.

Privacy

When you use AI actions (outline, analyze, optimize), relevant content may be sent to an external AI service to generate results.

No background tracking is performed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Settings → VDL AI SEO
  4. (Optional) Configure API / license settings
  5. Open a post or page and use the VDL AI SEO panel
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

To use AI-powered features, you may need an API key or license depending on your setup.

Does this work with the block editor?

Yes. VDL AI SEO integrates with the modern WordPress editor.

Is this plugin free?

The plugin is free to install. Some AI features may require an external service.
